# Repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and do only the task assigned to you in [TASKS.md](../TASKS.md).

- Work in your own folder (`C:\Users\iansc\proxyforge-copilot`); never switch to another agent's branch.
- Work on a branch from the latest `origin/main` and open a pull request; never push to `main` or merge
  your own PR.
- Before opening a PR, run `npm run verify`, `npm run real-cards` and `npm run safe-area`, and report any
  failure in the PR, even one you think isn't yours.
- Never commit, copy or deploy `godzilla-series.md`, `playtest guides.txt`, `RECOMMENDATIONS.md`,
  `references/`, `art/`, `proxy-forge.local.html`, `*.png` or `*.pdf`.
- Never add a `Co-Authored-By` line naming a tool you are not.
- Don't rewrite tests to make them pass; attach screenshots for visual changes.
